The Launch Constitution

The joke must survive on the front alone.

  1. One print area: production starts front-only.
  2. Selective ceremony: seals, Latin, and heraldry appear only when they sharpen the idea.
  3. Extended provenance: QR stories, titles, and lineage begin online or in packaging—not as compulsory garment decoration.

Front-art prototype · Two inks

The regalia,
reduced to what prints.

This transparent 4500 × 5400 vector composition translates the Realm concept into one centered front print. It is editable artwork—not a flattened mockup—and deliberately excludes sleeve decoration, back copy, and a garment QR code.
